comment: Lab description, independent of the hypervisor (ADR-0025). A provider (lab/providers/<name>) turns it into virtual machines; the guest scripts (lab/guest) read the per-machine part from the configuration medium. Passwords are never written here: they are drawn at each run.

host.comment: The host runs the core under test and the lab control service. It owns the gateway address of each segment.
host.name: bastion

dmz.comment: Isolated zone of the Windows gateway agent: no inbound flow at all, outbound only to the core on the host and to the targets.

accounts.comment: Test accounts created at each run, with generated passwords.

domain.name: ostena-user1
domain.purpose: RDP user allowed on the members

domain.name: ostena-user2
domain.purpose: domain user without RDP right (refusal tests)

service.name: ostena-http
service.purpose: Kerberos SPNEGO service account of the core, keytab exported

local.name: ostena-local
local.purpose: local account on each member, RDP allowed (non-domain tests)
